title: Treatise on the Binding Whirl
summary: Teaches how to whirl the chain into a wrap that pins a limb, then spend it in a spiral of casts.

title: Manual of the Hooked Reach
summary: Sets out long-range hook work, from catching a moving foe to a piercing throw of the kama point.

title: The Counter-Weight Method
summary: Trains the user to fight from the balance between blade hand and weight hand, with anchored trip lines.

title: Master's Course in Chain and Kama
summary: A senior course that interlocks chain lashes and kama cuts and ends in a full reaping sweep.

title: Twin-Track Chain and Kama Course
summary: Teaches blade hand and weight hand as two tracks, with paired hawk strikes and a hidden loop of chain.

title: Hawk-Stoop Treatise of the Weighted Chain
summary: Teaches the high circling weight and the plunging cast that falls on a raised guard like a stooping hawk.

title: Azure Basin Treatise on Hook and Weight
summary: Sets out the basin-rim stance, river-bend casts and a circling reap, for students of a high standing.

title: Wind-Sworn Treatise on the Long Chain
summary: Teaches the full-length chain cast and the open-ground reaping wheel of the wind-sworn schools.

title: Plateau Edge Manual of the Kama
summary: Teaches fighting at a cliff line, hooking foes toward the drop and chaining cuts along the rim.

title: Bearing-Taken Treatise on Weight and Hook
summary: Teaches reading the wind to place the weight and hook, ending in a reaping spiral and a held chain lock.
